title: (Scripture Reading Exercise.)
author: B. H. Roberts
note: Second Year of the Seventy's Course in Theology. Covers the dispensations of the Gospel.

footnotes.text: St. John's Gospel gives the most complete account of John the Baptists' ministry, and hence is given precedency here. The same method is followed on other topics; that is, the evangelist or authority giving the fullest or most important information is given precedence.
